visit_title: John preparing for a Melchizedek Priesthood Advancement
summary: Your conversation with John focused on his readiness to advance in the priesthood from Aaronic to Melchizedek (elder). You taught that the priesthood is God’s authority delegated to man, emphasizing how the Aaronic priesthood administers outward ordinances (like baptism and the sacrament) while the Melchizedek priesthood brings higher spiritual responsibility, personal revelation, and stewardship in the home. You walked him through Doctrine and Covenants 20, explaining the duties of priests, teachers, and deacons, and highlighted that advancement raises expectations for personal worthiness and repentance. You then conducted a full temple recommend–style interview, confirming his faith in Christ, acceptance of restored priesthood authority, commitment to live church standards (including tithing going forward), and his own sense of worthiness. You told John you see no reason to delay his advancement, will recommend him to the stake president for ordination to the office of elder, issue him a limited-use recommend now, and encouraged him to prepare for the temple endowment and to continue leading his family with patience and love, especially regarding his wife’s gradual spiritual journey.
